graphs.label: BioBricks AOP-Wiki
graphs.description: BioBricks AOP-Wiki is an open knowledge graph for Adverse Outcome Pathways from the AOP-Wiki.

graphs.label: BioBricks ICE
graphs.description: BioBricks ICE (Integrated Chemical Environment) is an open knowledge graph for cheminformatics and chemical safety data from EPA's CompTox database.

graphs.label: BioBricks MeSH
graphs.description: BioBricks MeSH is an open knowledge graph of Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) biomedical vocabulary.

graphs.label: BioBricks PubChem Annotations
graphs.description: BioBricks PubChem Annotations is an open knowledge graph of chemical annotations from PubChem.

graphs.label: BioBricks Tox21
graphs.description: BioBricks Tox21 is an open knowledge graph for Tox21 toxicology screening data.

graphs.label: BioBricks ToxCast
graphs.description: BioBricks ToxCast is an open knowledge graph for EPA ToxCast high-throughput screening data.

graphs.label: Bio-Health KG
graphs.description: Bio-Health KG is a dynamically-updated open knowledge network for health, integrating biomedical insights with social determinants of health.

graphs.label: BiomarkerKB KG
graphs.description: The BiomarkerKB knowledge graph is a structured network that connects biomarkers to diseases, drugs, biological entities, and evidence from the scientific literature.

graphs.label: Climate Models KG
graphs.description: Climate Models KG is a knowledge graph to support evaluation and development of climate models.

graphs.label: DREAM-KG
graphs.description: Develop Dynamic, REsponsive, Adaptive, and Multifaceted Knowledge Graphs to Address Homelessness With Explainable AI

graphs.label: EvoWeb
graphs.description: EvoWeb - An Open Knowledge Graph of Co-evolving Genes (NIAID)

graphs.label: SAWGraph FRS KG
graphs.description: The FRS (Facility Registry Service) KG is the part of the SAWGraph project that stores data about facilities from EPA's Facility Registry service (FRS) together with their NAICS industry classification and the spatial location.

graphs.label: Gene Expression Atlas
graphs.description: Selected studies from the Gene Expression Atlas (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/gxa/home).

graphs.label: GEOCONNEX
graphs.description: Geoconnex is an open, community-driven knowledge graph linking U.S. hydrologic features to enable seamless water data discovery, access, and collaborative monitoring.

graphs.label: SAWGraph Hydrology KG
graphs.description: The Hydrology KG is the part of the SAWGraph project that describes streams, waterbodies and wells and their locations.

graphs.label: ID Mappings
graphs.description: Mappings using standard RDF predicates between Wikidata entities and external identifiers represented as RDF IRIs

graphs.label: FDA MAUDE Adverse Event Knowledge Graph
graphs.description: Knowledge graph constructed from FDA MAUDE adverse event reports using standardized FDA product codes.

graphs.label: NASA-GESDISC-KG
graphs.description: The NASA Knowledge Graph Dataset is an expansive graph-based dataset designed to integrate and interconnect information about satellite datasets, scientific publications, instruments, platforms, projects, data centers, and science keywords. This knowledge graph is particularly focused on datasets managed by NASA's Distributed Active Archive Centers (DAACs), which are NASA's data repositories responsible for archiving and distributing scientific data. In addition to NASA DAACs, the graph includes datasets from 184 data providers worldwide, including various government agencies and academic institutions.

graphs.label: NCI-PID 2.0 KG
graphs.description: The NCI-PID 2.0 Knowledge Graph converts NCI Pathway Interaction Database version 2.0 networks into RDF, capturing protein interactions, signaling pathways, and post-translational modifications enriched with INDRA evidence metadata.

graphs.label: NIAID Data Ecosystem KG
graphs.description: The nde (NIAID Data Ecosystem) KG contains infectious and immune-mediated disease datasets. These include datasets from NIAID-funded repositories as well as globally-relevant infectious and immune-mediated disease (IID) repositories from NIH and beyond. The datasets include -omics data, clinical data, epidemiological data, pathogen-host interaction data, flow cytometry, and imaging.

graphs.label: Neighborhood Information KG
graphs.description: Neighborhood Information KG (NIKG) is a knowledge graph warehouse for neighborhood information.

graphs.label: Open Annotations for Rare Diseases (OARD) Knowledge Graph
graphs.description: Clinical associations between rare diseases and phenotypes derived from electronic health records

graphs.label: OKN VoID graph descriptions
graphs.description: Collected VoID (Vocabulary of Interlinked Datasets) metadata for all OKN graphs

graphs.label: PanKgraph
graphs.description: PanKgraph — PanKbase Knowledge Graph (NIDDK)

graphs.label: PHASES KG
graphs.description: Knowledge graph Promoting Healthy Aging through Semantic Enrichment

graphs.label: Protein Knowledge Network
graphs.description: The Protein Knowledge Network (ProKN) integrates protein-centric data with the genomic-centric datasets of the Common Fund Data Ecosystem (CFDE), spanning heterogeneous biological data types across multiple domains to foster CFDE re-use and collaboration through enhanced connectivity and data integration, enabling new capabilities for functional genomics and systems-level understanding of disease mechanisms.

graphs.label: Rare Disease Knowledge Graph
graphs.description: RDKG is an open knowledge graph for rare diseases that integrates standardized disease identifiers and cross-references to support discovery and evidence synthesis.

graphs.label: Rural Resilience KG
graphs.description: Rural Resilience KG is a cross-domain knowledge graph to integrate health and justice for rural resilience.

graphs.label: SAWGraph PFAS KG
graphs.description: The Safe Agricultural Products and Water Graph (SAWGraph) PFAS KG stores data on PFAS observations and releases, describing the samples, the geospatial features they were taken from, the sampled environmental media, the specific chemical substances and the measurement values observed.

graphs.label: SCALES
graphs.description: SCALES is an integrated justice platform to connect criminal justice data across data silos.

graphs.label: SecureChain KG
graphs.description: SecureChain is a knowledge graph for resilient, trustworthy, and secure software supply chains.

graphs.label: SemOpenAlex
graphs.description: Comprehensive information on scientific publications and related entities.

graphs.label: SOC-KG
graphs.description: The Soil Organic Carbon Knowledge Graph (SOCKG) enhances robust soil carbon modeling, which is crucial for voluntary carbon markets.

graphs.label: SAWGraph Spatial KG
graphs.description: The SAWGraph Spatial KG is part of the Safe Agricultural Products and Water Graph (SAWGraph) project. It contains all the Level 13 grid cells from the S2 grid as well as administrative regions of levels 1 to 3 (states, counties, and county subdivisions) and the spatial relationships between them for the 48 contiguous states in the U.S.

graphs.label: SPOKE GeneLab
graphs.description: The spoke-genelab KG complements the spokeokn (SPOKE Open Knowledge Network) KG and is designed to integrate omics data from NASA’s Open Science Data Repository (OSDR/GeneLab), which hosts results from spaceflight experiments.

graphs.label: SPOKE-OKN
graphs.description: The spoke-okn (SPOKE Open Knowledge Network) KG is a comprehensive biomedical and environmental health knowledge graph that integrates diverse data across genomics, environmental science, and public health.

graphs.label: SUDOKN
graphs.description: Supply and Demand Open Knowledge Network is an interconnected network of publicly available manufacturing capability data focused on Small and Medium-Sized Manufacturers.

graphs.label: Ubergraph
graphs.description: Integrated suite of OBO ontologies with precomputed inferred relationships

graphs.label: UF-OKN
graphs.description: The Urban Flooding Open Knowledge Network (UF-OKN) is an informational infrastructure built using knowledge graphs aiming to extract structured content from the information scattered across open-source geospatial datasets and hydrologic models.

graphs.label: Wikidata
graphs.description: Wikidata is a free and open knowledge base that can be read and edited by both humans and machines

graphs.label: Wildlife-KN
graphs.description: This project seeks to create a comprehensive, integrative knowledge network for the management of wildlife in the context of climate change
